cues: The ring can still take part in electrophilic substitution, and chlorine has a split personality.
Its inductive effect pulls electrons out of the ring, so the ring reacts more slowly than benzene: deactivating.
But its resonance effect pushes lone pair density into the ring, specifically at the ortho and para positions, so that is where the electrophile goes: ortho para directing.
Para usually wins, because the ortho position is crowded.
